definitionZh: 背景复制 CSS 的短手属性设置背景图像如何重复 。 背景图像可以沿着水平轴和垂直轴重复,或者完全不重复.
sourceDefinition: The background-repeat CSS shorthand property sets how background images are repeated. A background image can be repeated along the horizontal and vertical axes, or not repeated at all.
